AWPTCM-T43859.objective:
• From a VRF instance, the command "traceroute vrf x.x.x.x" produces trace route output showing the network hops from the source VRF to the destination network.
  • From the global VRF, the standard "traceroute x.x.x.x" command produces the expected trace route output.
  • VRF-Lite correctly isolates the traceroute operation to the specified VRF instance.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.
From a VRF instance, run the command "traceroute vrf <name> x.x.x.x". Verify that the trace route output shows network hops from the source VRF to the destination network.
From the global VRF, run the command "traceroute x.x.x.x". Verify the expected trace route output.
Verify that traceroute from one VRF does not leak into another VRF instance.
